description: EXPLAIN returns the plan in the account's tabular shape - ten columns: step, id, parentOperators, operation, objects, alias, expressions, partitionsTotal, partitionsAssigned, bytesAssigned - with a GlobalStats row first and then one row per operator, each naming its parent. A full SELECT lays out Result / SortWithLimit / Aggregate / Filter / TableScan in that order, an equality join is an InnerJoin over the scan of one side and a JoinFilter over the other's, a scan names its table fully qualified with the partitions it reads, and EXPLAIN USING TABULAR is the default shape spelled out. Every test skips snowflake: the tables here are empty, which the account's optimizer answers with a single Generator, and it spells the expressions its own way.
